# Top Hat

> > Top Hat is a higher education technology platform providing interactive courseware, student engagement tools, and teaching solutions for colleges and universities.

Top Hat offers classroom technology including the Top Hat Marketplace for digital courseware, active learning tools, and assessment solutions. The company, led by CEO Mike Silagadze, serves institutions globally with a focus on student engagement, affordability, and pedagogical innovation in both physical and virtual classrooms.

## Teaching Strategies & Best Practices

- [5 Essential Strategies for Creating Collaborative Remote Classrooms](https://tophat.com/blog/5-essential-strategies-for-creating-collaborative-remote-classrooms): Five strategies for fostering collaboration in remote teaching environments
- [5 Rules For Selecting The Right Classroom Technology](https://tophat.com/blog/digital-vs-analog): Professor Kwame Brown's rules for blending digital and analog tools
- [4 Surprising Ways To Boost Classroom Attendance](https://tophat.com/blog/ideas-for-boosting-classroom-attendance): Four strategies to improve student attendance and engagement in class
- [How to Succeed at Course Transformation in a Big Class](https://tophat.com/blog/big-class-transformation): University of Pittsburgh's approach to transforming large biology courses
- [Why Student Insight Is Essential In The Virtual Classroom](https://tophat.com/blog/why-student-insight-is-essential-in-the-virtual-classroom): Using data-driven insights to support students in virtual classrooms

## Student Success & Well-Being

- [How to Help Students Overcome Impostor Syndrome](https://tophat.com/blog/student-impostor-syndrome): Guide to helping students overcome impostor syndrome with teaching tips
- [What Students Need to Succeed in Today's College Classroom](https://tophat.com/blog/what-students-need-to-succeed-in-todays-college-classroom): Essential factors for student success in online college classrooms
- [Graduate Student Challenges Amidst A Pandemic](https://tophat.com/blog/graduate-student-challenges): COVID-19 impact on graduate students' research, teaching, and finances

## Assessment & Learning Innovation

- [How Formative Assessment Helps Prepare Students for a Career](https://tophat.com/blog/formative-assessment-career): WSU's Leslie Sprunger uses peer assessment in veterinary education
- [The Evolution of Testing: Student Assessment Through the Ages](https://tophat.com/blog/evolution-of-testing-student-assessment): History of student assessment from medieval oral exams to AI grading
- [Top Hat Content: A Must-Have For Over 2,000 Students](https://tophat.com/blog/student-user-survey): Student survey results on Top Hat courseware engagement and retention
